commit_message: Replay ADR0126 Timeline work on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the validated ADR0126 Timeline core, shared authoring contracts, CLI/MCP capability adapters, and transient Game View camera override onto current main through the canonical producer/Dispatcher path. The replay includes the camera selector lint correction detected by Windows Validation #796.

This fresh task branch supersedes the stale-base work in Draft PR #245. Keep this PR Draft and unmerged while the remaining ADR0126 first-release requirements are completed and validated.
